data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 28/1144Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: POLO STILL A MAJOR HURRICANE AS IT APPROACHES THE BAJA CALIFORNIA PENINSULA. ...LIFE-THREATENING WINDS AND FLASH FLOODS EXPECTED OVER PORTIONS OF BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR AND SONORA TODAY AND TUESDAY... As of 5:00 AM MST Mon Sep 28 the center of Polo was located near 23.9, -113.7 with movement NNE at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 958 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 115 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Fay (AT1), advisory 28/1439Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY MOVING SOUTH-SOUTHWESTWARD OVER THE CENTRAL ATLANTIC. As of 3:00 PM GMT Mon Sep 28 the center of Fay was located near 27.1, -44.6 with movement SSW at 9 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1011 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Rachel (EP3), advisory 28/1438Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL A LITTLE STRONGER AS IT MOVES WEST-NORTHWESTWARD. ...TROPICAL STORM WARNING ISSUED FOR A PORTION OF THE COAST OF SOUTHWESTERN MEXICO... As of 9:00 AM CST Mon Sep 28 the center of Rachel was located near 13.8, -101.2 with movement WNW at 8 mph. The minimum central pressure was 999 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 50 mph.
